storeInfo.name: The Towne Parlor
storeInfo.tagline: Classic American Comfort & Artisan Pizza | Comida reconfortante y pizza artesanal

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en el lote contiguo o en la calle.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Parking available in adjacent lot or street parking.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y plataformas de entrega locales.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and local delivery platforms.

products.descriptionEs: Anillos de calamar ligeramente empanizados, servidos con salsa marinara casera y limón.
products.descriptionEn: Lightly breaded calamari rings served with house-made marinara and lemon wedges.

products.descriptionEs: Alitas de pollo jugosas bañadas en nuestra salsa picante secreta, servidas con aderezo blue cheese.
products.descriptionEn: Juicy chicken wings tossed in our signature spicy sauce, served with blue cheese dressing.

products.descriptionEs: Carne de res premium, queso cheddar añejo, tocino ahumado, lechuga y tomate en pan brioche.
products.descriptionEn: Premium beef patty, aged cheddar, smoked bacon, lettuce, and tomato on a toasted brioche bun.

products.descriptionEs: Masa fermentada 48 horas, salsa de tomate San Marzano, mozzarella fresca y albahaca.
products.descriptionEn: 48-hour fermented dough, San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella, and basil.

products.descriptionEs: Espagueti al dente con panceta crujiente, huevo, queso parmesano y pimienta negra.
products.descriptionEn: Al dente spaghetti with crispy pancetta, egg, parmesan cheese, and cracked black pepper.

products.descriptionEs: Limonada fresca hecha en casa con un toque floral de lavanda.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh house-made lemonade with a delicate floral hint of lavender.

products.descriptionEs: Cebollas caramelizadas a fuego lento en caldo rico de res, cubiertas con pan rústico tostado y queso Gruyère derretido.
products.descriptionEn: Slow-caramelized onions in a rich beef broth, topped with toasted rustic bread and melted Gruyère cheese.

products.descriptionEs: Cabecitas de coliflor asadas a la leña, servidas con salsa tahini de limón, granada fresca y piñones tostados.
products.descriptionEn: Wood-fired roasted cauliflower florets served with zesty lemon tahini sauce, fresh pomegranate, and toasted pine nuts.

products.descriptionEs: Tres mini hamburguesas de cerdo ahumado a fuego lento, salsa barbacoa casera y ensalada de repollo crujiente en pan brioche.
products.descriptionEn: Three mini slow-smoked pulled pork sliders with house barbecue sauce and crispy coleslaw on brioche buns.

products.nameEs: Croquetas de Jamón y Queso Manchego
products.descriptionEs: Croquetas crujientes por fuera y cremosas por dentro, elaboradas con jamón serrano y auténtico queso Manchego curado.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy on the outside and creamy on the inside croquettes made with serrano ham and authentic aged Manchego cheese.

products.descriptionEs: Tierno pulpo a la parrilla sobre puré de papa al romero, aceite de oliva virgen extra y pimentón ahumado.
products.descriptionEn: Tender grilled baby octopus served over rosemary mashed potatoes with extra virgin olive oil and smoked paprika.

products.descriptionEs: Pan rústico al horno de leña con tomates heirloom marinados, albahaca fresca, ajo y reducción de balsámico añejo.
products.descriptionEn: Wood-fired rustic bread topped with marinated heirloom tomatoes, fresh basil, garlic, and aged balsamic reduction.

products.descriptionEs: Costillas de res cocinadas a fuego lento durante 12 horas en vino tinto, sobre polenta cremosa y verduras de temporada.
products.descriptionEn: 12-hour slow-cooked beef short ribs in red wine reduction, served over creamy polenta and seasonal vegetables.

products.descriptionEs: Medio pollo orgánico marinado con finas hierbas y limón, acompañado de papas doradas de granja y espárragos al grill.
products.descriptionEn: Half organic chicken marinated in fine herbs and lemon, served with golden farm potatoes and grilled asparagus.

products.descriptionEs: Filete de salmón fresco glaseado con miel y mostaza dijon, acompañado de risotto de quinoa y vegetales salteados.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh Atlantic salmon fillet glazed with honey and dijon mustard, served with quinoa risotto and sautéed vegetables.

products.descriptionEs: Corte tierno de carne de res angus a la parrilla, mantequilla de trufa, papas fritas trufadas y salsa chimichurri.
products.descriptionEn: Tender grilled Angus beef tenderloin with truffle butter, truffle fries, and house chimichurri sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Arroz arborio cremoso cocinado con una mezcla de hongos silvestres, queso parmesano reggiano y un toque de aceite de trufa blanca.
products.descriptionEn: Creamy Arborio rice cooked with a mix of wild mushrooms, Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese, and a hint of white truffle oil.

products.nameEs: Pizza Artesanal de Trufa y Hongos
products.descriptionEn: Slow-fermented sourdough crust, fior di latte mozzarella, porcini mushrooms, white truffle oil, and fresh parsley.
San Marzano tomato base, fresh mozzarella, cured Prosciutto di Parma, wild arugula, and shaved Parmigiano.

products.nameEs: Pizza Picante de Salame de Calabria
products.descriptionEn: Tomato sauce, melted mozzarella, spicy Calabrian salami, house hot honey, and fresh basil leaves.

products.nameEs: Pizza Cuatro Quesos con Miel de Higo
products.nameEn: Four Cheese Pizza with Fig Honey
products.descriptionEn: Blend of mozzarella, gorgonzola, fontina, and goat cheese, drizzled with artisanal fig honey.

products.nameEs: Pizza Blanca de Espinacas y Ricotta
products.descriptionEn: No tomato sauce. Mozzarella cheese, creamy goat ricotta, garlic baby spinach, and lemon zest.
House marinara sauce, mozzarella, mini beef and pork meatballs, fresh ricotta, and basil.

products.nameEs: Cóctel Old Fashioned Ahumado con Bourbon
products.descriptionEn: Artisanal bourbon, Angostura bitters, cane sugar, infused with applewood smoke and orange peel.
Artisanal mezcal, Cointreau, fresh lime juice, agave syrup, and jalapeño slices with a worm salt rim.
Freshly squeezed house lemonade, puree of fresh wild blackberries, mint leaves, and sparkling water.

products.nameEs: Cerveza Artesanal IPA Local de CT
products.descriptionEn: New England-style IPA brewed right here in Connecticut, featuring highly aromatic citrus and tropical notes.

products.nameEs: Té Helado de Durazno y Jengibre
products.descriptionEn: Freshly brewed black tea infused with natural sweet peach purée and a spicy kick of fresh ginger.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, pregunte a nuestro personal por las opciones marcadas en el menú.
faqs.aEn: Yes, please ask our staff for items marked on the menu.

faqs.aEs: Aceptamos clientes sin reservación y reservaciones por teléfono.
faqs.aEn: We welcome walk-ins and phone reservations.
